platform.name: VaultOfCode
platform.description: VaultOfCode is a premier hands-on software development education and virtual internship platform designed to empower students with industry-relevant skills.
platform.workingHours: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST, Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM IST

internships.title: Web Development Virtual Internship
internships.stipend: Performance-based stipend awarded to top 5% interns in each cohort.

workshops.title: Building GenAI Apps with Gemini & React

certificates.verificationProcess: Navigate to the Certificate Verification page (/verify-certificate), enter your unique Certificate ID (e.g. VOC-2026-8921), and click 'Verify Credentials'.
certificates.deliveryTimeline: Digital e-certificates are dispatched to your registered email address within 3 to 5 business days after passing project review.

offerLetters.issuance: Offer letters are generated and emailed within 48 hours of successful internship enrollment.
offerLetters.verification: Can be viewed and validated via the Offer Letter Portal at /offer-letter.
offerLetters.notReceivedHelp: If you have not received your offer letter after 48 hours, check your Spam folder or contact our support team on WhatsApp.

enrollmentAndPayments.enrollmentSteps: 1. Browse Courses or Internships. 2. Click 'Apply Now'. 3. Fill required profile details. 4. Complete payment. 5. Receive confirmation email & student dashboard login instantly.
enrollmentAndPayments.refundPolicy: We offer a 100% full refund policy within 7 days of course enrollment if you are not satisfied. Refund requests after 7 days or post certificate generation cannot be fulfilled.

technicalSupport.loginIssues: To reset your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page (/login) or enter your registered email.
technicalSupport.lmsIssues: If video lectures or assignments fail to load, clear your browser cache/cookies or try Google Chrome.
technicalSupport.submissionIssues: Assignments must be submitted as a GitHub Repository URL or a zip file uploaded to your student portal.
